title: Fluid tab rail
description: A deep-blue navigation rail swells around the focused control while a pale disc follows its silhouette.
useCase: Connect hover preview, keyboard focus and selected workspace state with one coherent navigation shape.
interaction: Hover or select a mode. Arrow keys, Home and End select immediately.
reducedMotion: The rail and disc move directly to the target with no interpolated motion.
limitations: Four local modes with symbolic previews; connect the selected index to real panels in a product.
look: Dark navy page with a centred line icon and large sans-serif label above a slate pill-shaped icon rail whose bulge cradles a pale mint disc.
motion: Hovering a tab glides a pale disc there (exponential smoothing, 65 ms constant) while a Gaussian bulge in the SVG rail follows; leaving glides it back, keyboard moves are instant.
adapt: The disc `point` eases in a `requestAnimationFrame` loop (`Math.exp(-dt / 65)`) and the rail `hull` is rebuilt each frame from the Gaussian `profile` (spread 32, height 13). Replace `LABELS` and `SYMBOLS`; the 68 px tab pitch and count of four are hard-coded.
